events.title: GC Hub Toastmasters Weekly Meeting
events.source: Gold Coast to Tweed Speakers & Leaders
events.description: A supportive and structured environment where members practice public speaking and leadership skills through prepared speeches and impromptu table topics. Ideal for those looking to improve communication in a community-focused, small-group setting.

events.title: Saturday Board Games Night at The Old Post Office
events.description: An inclusive, recurring social gathering focused on modern board games. This event encourages face-to-face interaction and strategy, providing a relaxed atmosphere for meeting local people who enjoy tabletop gaming.
